overview_description.description:
Jobedu designs, manufactures, and retails apparel and accessories. It offers T-shirts, hoodies, sweaters, and zip-up hoodies for men, women, and kids; tank tops for women; and onesies for kids. 

Jobedu also provides posters, sketchbooks, notebooks, bookmarks, stickers, and postcards; caps; and mugs, pillows, keychains, and coasters. It offers products through its stores and online worldwide. 

Tamer Al-MasriJobedu founded Jobedu on June 28, 2007. It has its headquarters in Amman in Jordan.
